guard: The test-only issued lifecycle stages source indexes before the existing agent-mint fence, activates only at the original prepared revision and refuses resolution after revocation. This is a localhost gate-composition proof, without production issuer or barrier attachment. Root-source resolution also uses the real credential reader with signature-validated bearer provenance and refuses revoked, expired or head-mismatched credentials. The isolated credential-row fence covers both explicit revoke/release orders; production issuer and revoker attachment remain unproved.
